FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 29 January 1980, after the draft finalized by the Pest Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council and the Chernical Division Council. 0.2 Butachlor granules are used as herbicide in ih� agricultural field. 0.3 Butachlor granules are generally manufactured to contain 5 percent (m/m) ofbutachlor.
0.4 In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the provisions of the Insecticides Act, 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under these, wherever applicable.

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded oft'value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. .Jl

1. SCOPE

�

1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for butachlor granules.

2. REQ,UlREMENTS
2.1 eo�� titaeat8- The material shall consist of butachlor, technical as the only active ingredient impregnated on suitable carrier(s) together with binder(s), stabilizer'[s] and/or other formulants. 2.1.1 Butachlor, technical employed in the formulation of this material shall conform to IS : 9355-1980t.
*Rules for roundilll off numerical values ( "wsld ). tSpecificatioD Corbutachlor, technical.

3

IS : 9362-1980

2.2 Physical-'I'he material shall comply with the physica] requirernents specified in 2.2.1 to 2.2.5.
2.2.1 Dt'S(r;jJlioll-'fhc product shall consist of dry, free flowing granules, free from visible extraneous mutter and d list except for the amount specified (.~(t1 2.2.3). It IHay contain added colouring matter. When dusted from a granule applicator, the material shall come freely without clogging or bridging the apparatus.

2.2.2 Particle Si~e-Not less than 97 percent by mass of the product shall pass through a test sieve having a nu-sh aize of the upper declared limit and not more than 5 percent by Blass of the product shall pass through a test sieve having a mesh size of lower declared limit when determined by the method described in 12.2 of IS : 6940-197:l* [see 3.2 (a) ].
2.2.2.1 The ratio of lower to upper particle sizes shall not exceed 1 : 2.

2.2.3 Dust>- When determined by the method described in 12.2 of IS: 6940-1973*, not more than 1�0 percent hy mass of the product shall pass by mass through 75-Jnicron IS Sieve (fff' IS : 460-1 <)62"'-).
2.2.3.1 The portion passing through this sieve shall not contain more than 8 percent by Blass of the declared nominal active ingredient when detcr rn ined by the method described in Appendix A

2.2.4 Storage Stabilily 2.2.4.1 Heat stability-After storage at 54 � 2�C for 14 days the product shall continue to comply with the' requirements of 2.2.1 to 2.2.4, 2.3.1 and 2,3.2. 2.2.5 Moisture Content- Wht'n determined by the method prescribed in 4 of IS : 6940-1973*, the moisture content of the material shall not exceed 4�0 percent by mass
2.3 Chemical-The material shall comply with the chemical requiremerits specified in 2.3.1 and 2.3.2.

2.3.1 Butachlor Content - When determined by the method prescribed in Appendix A, the observed butachJor content, percent (mJm), of anyof the samples shall not differ from the nominal value by more than the percent tolerance applied to the declared nominal value as given below:

3. PACKING AND MARKING

3.1 Packiag-rrhc material shall be packed as per requirements given in IS : 8190 (Part I)-1980t.
3.2 MarkiDg- The containers shall bear legibly and indelibly the following information and any other information as is necessary under the Insecticides Act and Rule's:

N arne of the mater ial and particle size (set 2.2.2); Name of the manufacturer; Date of manufacture; Batch number; Net mass of the contents; Nominal butachlor content, percent (m/TIl); and g) Avcautionary notice worded as in the Insecticides Act and Rules.

The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
